description: This file contains unit tests for a file watcher component called CanvasFileWatcher, specifically testing its ability to detect in-place modifications of files within a directory on macOS.

classes.name: CanvasFileWatcher
classes.description: A component that watches a directory for file changes and executes a callback when changes are detected.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary directory URL used for testing.

methods.name: detects in place file writes
methods.description: Unit test that verifies CanvasFileWatcher detects in-place file modifications.
